id: Cyllage City\nThe city of peaceful strolls.
en: Cyllage City\nThe city of peaceful strolls.

id: \bI've been on a long journey. Soon I will discover the meaning to Mega Evolution.
en: \bI've been on a long journey. Soon I will discover the meaning to Mega Evolution.
it: \bHo fatto un lungo viaggio. Presto scoprirò il significato della Megaevoluzione.

id: \bI never want to stop fishing. I could do it to the end of time.
en: \bI never want to stop fishing. I could do it to the end of time.
it: \bNon voglio mai smettere di pescare. Potrei farlo fino alla fine dei tempi.

id: \bGrant used a Pokémon I've never seen before! How am I supposed to win if I don't know what to fight?
en: \bGrant used a Pokémon I've never seen before! How am I supposed to win if I don't know what to fight?
it: \bLino ha usato un Pokémon che non avevo mai visto! Come faccio a vincere se non so contro cosa combatto?

id: \bGrant has this strange rule where he encourages challengers to use their whole team. How confident is that guy?
en: \bGrant has this strange rule where he encourages challengers to use their whole team. How confident is that guy?
it: \bLino ha questa strana regola per cui incoraggia gli sfidanti a usare tutta la squadra. Quanto è sicuro di sé quel tizio?

id: \rI need to pass this on to someone else.
en: \rI need to pass this on to someone else.
it: \rDevo trasmettere questa cosa a qualcun altro.

id: \bThis path is pretty tough. I try to hike it every day.
en: \bThis path is pretty tough. I try to hike it every day.
it: \bQuesto sentiero è piuttosto impegnativo. Cerco di percorrerlo ogni giorno.

id: \bYou would think we would have a Water gym here. But no, we just get boring rocks.
en: \bYou would think we would have a Water gym here.  But no, we just get boring rocks.
it: \bUno penserebbe che qui ci sia una Palestra di tipo Acqua. E invece no, ci tocca una noiosa Palestra di rocce.

id: \bSomewhere in town they are giving away free revived fossils. They hit a jackpot and are promoting the research.
en: \bSomewhere in town they are giving away free revived fossils. They hit a jackpot and are promoting the research.
it: \bDa qualche parte in città regalano fossili rianimati. Hanno fatto jackpot e ora stanno promuovendo la ricerca.

id: The wild, yet cool and collected, rock climber.
en: The wild, yet cool and collected, rock climber.
it: Lo scalatore selvaggio, ma calmo e composto.
